map.算法：弧长 L = r·θ（θ 必须为弧度）；度转弧度 θ = deg·π/18: Algorithm: arc length L = r·theta (theta must be in radians); degrees to radians theta = deg·pi/180. Degrees can be entered and are converted automatically. Requires r>0 and deg>=0 (the result grows linearly with deg).
map.例：r=10m、θ=90° → 弧度=90×π/180=1.5708、L=10×: Example: r=10m, theta=90 degrees gives radians=90xpi/180=1.5708, L=10x1.5708=15.7080m. For theta=60 degrees, radians=1.0472 and L=10.4720m (a 90 degree arc is exactly 1.5x that of 60 degrees, matching the 1/4 vs 1/6 circle ratio).
map.是的，弧长公式 L=r·θ 在 θ 取弧度时成立；若直接把角度代入会得到错误结果: Yes, L=r·theta holds only for theta in radians; substituting degrees directly gives a wrong result. The tool converts degrees internally, so enter the angle but mind the unit labels.
